messages:
Sam H.: Morning async — quick SRE check-in
Sam H.: What I did: looked into generation-latency spike overnight. Alert fired on router->model-handoff 95th pct. Tracing shows a surge of transient 5xx from model-proxy that coincided with a routing rollout.
Sam H.: Blockers: can't reproduce locally because feature-flag `new-routing` depends on a canary header we don't set in dev. Also need access to the canary tenant logs (requesting from infra).
Sam H.: Today: I will open a small rollback PR for the routing config, and coordinate with oncall to run a controlled canary replay. Filing a follow-up ticket.
Lia C.: Thanks Sam. I pulled traces — looks like the proxy retries amplified latency. I can add a short-term debounce on retries in the proxy (2 -> 1) to limit amplification.
Lia C.: Quick note: if we change retries, we should update the runbook section under "retry amplification" so oncall knows to revert.
Amir R.: @Sam H. sounds good. Please add the replay steps in the ticket. I can grant you access to canary logs — sending request now.
Amir R.: Also pinging infra: infra-ops, can we expose tenant-canary logs for 6 hours? @infra-ops :deploy: 
Joel P.: oncall-bot reported a small surge: `alert:router-5xx-rate` at 03:12, auto-mitigated by fallback routing but we still saw SLO burn. Details in the alert runbook.
oncall-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-482 — router-5xx-rate spike. Pager not escalated (burn < 10%).
Sam H.: Adding a snippet to the ticket for log queries — saves time when running the replay:
Sam H.: ```
# find router errors for canary tenant
rg "router.*5xx" /var/log/proxy/canary | sed -n '1,200p'
# prometheus: 5xx rate query
sum(rate(router_request_total{status=~"5..",tenant="canary"}[5m]))
```
Lia C.: That query looks good. If we need to patch live, here's the quick rollback command: `kubectl apply -f routing-config-stable.yaml -n inference` (keep replicaset min=2).
Amir R.: Assigned follow-ups: Sam -> PR for rollback, Lia -> proxy retry change + runbook edit, Joel -> coordinate replay window with infra. I'll own the ticket until closure.
Joel P.: I'll schedule the replay for 0900 PT and post the confirmation here (will include a short checklist).
Sam H.: Small ask: can someone glance at the alert thresholds? 95th of p95 seems noisy with bursts; maybe move to p99 for the routing-5xx for 10m window just while we stabilize.
Lia C.: +1 to raising to p99 temporarily. Add note to ticket so we don't forget to revert. :memo:
Joel P.: OK will add to checklist: "temporary threshold change -> revert after 24h if stable"
Sam H.: Thanks everyone. No blockers from my side after infra grants logs; I'll post PR link and replay results. :thumbsup:
Lia C.: :thumbsup:
Amir R.: Thanks — recording in INC-2026-482 and tagging oncall.
noncall-bot: (automated) replay scheduled: 2026-03-17T09:00:00-07:00 for tenant canary (operator: Joel P.).
Joel P.: Replay done at 09:05 — observed same brief 5xx bump, rollback PR merged at 09:12, SLO burn reduced. Will close incident after 24h observation.
Sam H.: Closing note: follow-up retro item: add an automated smoke test during routing rollouts to catch retry-amplified errors earlier. Created GH issue #5897.
